component.name: Viewrab
component.summary: Fast, simple PDF viewer with PDF/A validation

description.p: Viewrab is a fast, small and simple PDF viewer. It also checks documents against PDF/A, the archival form of PDF, and converts them to a conformant copy.

ul.li: Tabs, zoom, a page field, find, text selection and copy, and links
Verify against PDF/A-1b, PDF/A-2b or plain PDF structure, jump to the pages an issue is on, and convert to a conformant copy
Drag tabs to reorder them, move them between windows or tear them off into a new one
Light on memory: files are read by byte range and pages rendered in tiles under a bitmap budget
A light and a dark theme that follow the desktop
